verdict.rationale: The GitHub README documents a prebuilt container image of the open-source branch on GitHub Container Registry, bundling headless Chrome, LibreOffice and CJK fonts, so developers can run Reader themselves instead of calling the hosted r.jina.ai service. Self-hosted configuration such as an S3-compatible cache bucket is also documented, while the anti-bot proxy pool is explicitly a SaaS-only feature that needs a key. Missing for 10: an explicit license and a feature-parity statement between the open-source branch and the hosted service, a parity path for the SaaS-only proxy pool, and independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host an open-source version of the scraper instead of relying on a hosted cloud service
